steps.caption: The workspace: assigned tasks on the left, the task map on the right.
Filter the task list by name, priority, map suggestion, or status.
The Points control adds muted context dots; the legend explains marker states.
Hovering a marker shows the task name, status, and last activity.

title: Open a task and record evidence

steps.caption: Open a task from the list; the detail panel shows the brief and source links.
Choose what your evidence shows; target-year statuses prefill from the action.
Record the source title, date, URL, and a short evidence note.
Answer the change-class question: genuine change is counted by the annual census; map corrections rewrite history.

title: Save a draft, submit, and open the next task

steps.caption: Save draft keeps the task open while you work; the status line confirms the save.
Submit for review closes the task and confirms it in the panel.
Open next task lands you in the next available task in your filtered list.

title: Skip a task with a reason, then undo

steps.caption: The skip control sits under the evidence form for tasks with nothing to record.
Reason chips fill the skip reason with one click; free text still works.
Skipping confirms in the panel; Undo skip is right there if you change your mind.
Undo skip reopens the task and returns you to its detail panel.

title: Report a map issue from a task

steps.caption: Report an issue opens a small form under the evidence form.
Choose the issue type and describe what you noticed.
A new issue is filed as an open task for curator triage.
If an open issue already exists for the place, your note is added to it instead.

title: Nominate a missing place with a pin drop (Vanuatu)

steps.caption: Add missing place of worship lives in the nomination panel.
Click the map to drop a draggable pin; the confirm card tracks its position.
Below zoom 15 the confirm button stays disabled: placement must be building-accurate.
Zoom in to pass the gate, then confirm the location.
Existing tasks near the pin are offered first, with their distance and status.
Describe how you know the place; local knowledge counts, and the change-class question rides along.
Creating the candidate lands you in its task, ready for the normal evidence flow.
Changes requested pins the reviewer's note and required follow-up above My work.
Revise now opens an editable revision of your submission with the task detail loaded.
History shows the task's full event trail; your own actions are marked (you).
Hover any marker for the same provenance at a glance: name, status, last activity.

title: Review a submitted task and record a decision

steps.caption: The review queue lists submitted tasks with their status pills.
Selecting a task loads the evidence, lifecycle fields, and task history.
Choose a decision and write the decision note; the record stays yours.
Recording the decision returns you to the queue for the next task.

title: Read the AI review panel before deciding

steps.caption: The AI recommendation is labelled AI-generated, identifies its agent, provider, and model, and never decides for you.
Reasoning explains the recommendation in plain language.
Source checks record every outcome, including what could not be checked.
Use recommendation prefills the decision; Decide differently records disagreement — the note and Record button stay yours.
